events.summary: The project tested how to define transformer attention using only prompt input and concept-gate-taxonomy MCP output, while separating tool output from model interpretation.
The conversation identified recurring confusion between classificatory definition and compositional decomposition when names and code artifacts are treated as concepts.
FeatureType vocabulary exposure raised directed repair from the prior 0/10 pattern to 3/20, below the 0.80 threshold.
A combined global-consistency, complete-state, and schema-minItems contract produced 20/20.
OFAT ablation found A_ONLY 20/20, B_ONLY 1/20, and C_ONLY 0/20.
Generalization screening reported CONTROL 0/2, A_ONLY 10/10, A_PARAPHRASE 9/10, A_TOPOLOGY 9/10, and A_DECOY 10/10.
The next bridge experiment was designed around repo-only evidence sufficiency and a claim/abstain/repair boundary.
The user chose file-format canonical storage, conceptual classification through symlink views, Obsidian backlinks, and a typed edge ledger enriched by subagent keyword extraction.
Open-problem material should preserve source text, search literature before attempting a solution, date-bind status claims, and abstain when current status is uncertain.
